TSVAL: To compare the effects of Drug A and of Drug B with placebo on liver function (ALT, AST) and systemic inflammation (CRP) in adults with CLD
To evaluate the safety and tolerability of Drug A and Drug B compared with placebo from first dose through follow-up
To compare the magnitude and time course of changes in ALT, AST, CRP and HGB among the three treatment groups, including Drug A versus Drug B
To assess the proportion of participants achieving clinically meaningful improvements in laboratory biomarkers
Change from baseline to Week 12 in ALT
Change from baseline to Week 12 in AST
Change from baseline to Week 12 in CRP
Incidence, severity and relationship of treatment-emergent adverse events from first dose through follow-up
Mean change from baseline in ALT, AST, CRP and HGB at Weeks 4, 8 and 12 and at follow-up
Difference between Drug A and Drug B in mean change from baseline to Week 12 in ALT, AST, CRP and HGB
Proportion of participants achieving the predefined improvement in CRP, ALT, AST and HGB at Week 12
Change from baseline in vital signs at Weeks 4, 8 and 12 and at follow-up
The DSMB reviews unblinded safety data and may recommend modification or termination of the study for safety reasons only
Long-term Outcomes and Response Assessment of a Novel Agent (LORNA) Trial
